title: FEPCert: An Open-Source Toolkit for Quality-Control, Phase Space Overlap, and Thermodynamic Cycle Closure Certification of Alchemical Free Energy Simulations
description: An open-source scientific toolkit for rigorous quality assurance, phase space overlap matrix calculation (Bennett/Klimovich criteria), forward-reverse hysteresis evaluation, time-convergence profiling, and thermodynamic cycle closure analysis for alchemical free energy calculations (FEP, TI, BAR, MBAR).
